an3.47:1.1: “Bhikkhus, there are these three characteristics that define the conditioned.
an3.47:1.3: An arising is seen, a vanishing is seen, and its alteration while it persists is seen.
an3.47:1.4: These are the three characteristics that define the conditioned.
an3.47:2.1: “Bhikkhus, there are these three characteristics that define the unconditioned.
an3.47:2.3: No arising is seen, no vanishing is seen, and no alteration while it persists is seen.
an3.47:2.4: These are the three characteristics that define the unconditioned.”
